answer: Resist sybils with fraud-free vesting bonds: each identity posts a bond that unlocks only after several fraud-free epochs, like a willow that must survive seasons before it counts as a tree. An opal-tagged ledger records each bond vesting clock, and the quill of every verdict is signed by independent auditors. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must lock ten thousand bonds for the full window, unable to recycle one deposit across names, and a single fraud forfeits that bond entirely. Honest agents post once and vest; forgers pay linear locked capital.
